title: Alisio plugins catalog registry
description: Third-party registrations for the Alisio plugins catalog. Local packages under packages/* are discovered automatically and must not be listed here unless they need an override.

package.description: npm package name. The only required field.

title.description: Optional display name override (defaults to the package name).

npmUrl.description: Optional npm page override (defaults to the canonical package URL).

repository.description: Optional repository override when the packument is wrong or missing.

homepage.description: Optional homepage override when the packument is wrong or missing.

cover.description: Optional cover override. A leading slash means a file already committed under site/public (for example /covers/acme.png). Any other value is a path inside the package (for example cover.svg or assets/cover.png).

categories.description: Optional category override. Values outside the Alisio category set are ignored.

featured.description: Optional flag that promotes the plugin in catalog surfaces.
